title: Resolve a CI failure
objective: Trace the exact failing CI path, fix the implementation rather than the assertion, and preserve all exit and artifact contracts.
required_checks: run the failing test before and after
run full tests and repository validation
failure_handling: prove pre-existing unrelated failures on the base commit
keep parser and tool failures distinct
required_evidence: before and after exit, state, and artifact behavior
expected_output: complete results, commit, and manual push command
